title: Growing the Greenpill Impact Framework
dek: In March 2026, Greenpill opened a public thread to shape an impact framework for Green Goods across solar, agroforestry, education and waste management.
excerpt: An open process to define outcomes and indicators for Green Goods, starting with GreenWill badges.
body:
On March 25, 2026, as the first quarter closed, Afolabi opened a thread on the Regen Coordination Hub to keep the momentum around Green Goods v1 by developing the Greenpill Impact Framework in public. The goal was a first version concrete enough to put to use soon and flexible enough to evolve as Green Goods grows.

For Season One, Green Goods centers on four domains: solar, agroforestry, education and waste management. The thread asks practical questions: which outcomes matter in each domain, which indicators show whether they are happening, which metrics are realistic to track early on, and what should be shared across domains.

It also connects the framework to strategy and theory of change, the Common Impact Data Standard, partner frameworks such as DAOstar's DAO-IP5 and Octant Vaults, badging with Unlock Protocol, and "yield to impact": how the value a project generates relates to the impact it creates over time.

## First step: GreenWill badges

On April 6, 2026, Afolabi shared that the first implementation phase would run through GreenWill, the badge and recognition layer being designed for Green Goods. The work covered an onchain registry and badge issuance, the backend and indexer needed for eligibility and proof data, and the first interface updates for profile badges. The first planned badges were Genesis member, first submission and first support.
